_: Registered before any change was made to the app in this closure pass, and before any frame was rendered. The case list, the per-case expectation and the classification rubric below are fixed; results are recorded against them rather than the other way round.
coldness: one invocation is one cold browser with its own profile; every 27b: localStorage key is cleared before each case

frozen._: Not under test and not to be changed by this pass. Two cold reviews already established these; a camera change requires a frozen failing case, before evidence, a single-variable change, after evidence, the full regression matrix, and no loss on any previously passing case.
items: geocoding and building lookup, including the no-substitute-address rule
the footprint-derived facade method and the floor-height calculation

unavailableImagery: noimagery — 1 W 72nd St with tile.googleapis.com blocked

recordedPerCase: resolved address as the geocoder returned it
BIN and footprint identity (roof height, rectangularity)
floor and estimated eye height above ground, and camera height in NAVD88
camera bearings in degrees, per direction
obstruction classification per direction (open / enclosed / close range / no window)
all four frames, or the honest failure state
root-tileset requests (the billable unit) and renderer tile requests
console errors and warnings raised during the case

frameClassification._: Every frame is opened and looked at. 'Not blank' is not a classification. No frame may be altered, upscaled, denoised or generated to change its class.
frameClassification.Convincing: reads as a photograph of the city from that height and bearing; buildings, streets and skyline are coherent
frameClassification.Plausible but provider-limited: genuinely the right place and bearing, but the provider's mesh is soft, smeared or low-detail at this range
frameClassification.Obstructed and honestly labelled: the frame is mostly or entirely a near surface, AND the app said so before the picture (close range / enclosed / light court)
frameClassification.Unusable and correctly rejected: no frame was shown, and the app said why without substituting anything
frameClassification.Incorrect: wrong place, wrong bearing, fabricated content, or an obstruction the app did not declare

passConditions: every Obstructed frame carries its declaration in the copy above or beside it
the invalid address produces a refusal and no imagery request
the blocked-imagery case produces the honest failure state, empty frames, and no substituted content
the Google attribution line is present and unclipped wherever a frame is displayed
no console error other than ones raised deliberately by a blocked case

costCeiling.billableUnit: one root-tileset request per render session
costCeiling.price: first 1,000 per month free, then $6.00 per 1,000
costCeiling.hardStop: the harness aborts if root-tileset requests exceed --max-sessions
